title: Team Allocation Schedule Settings
description: Configure UI language and user groups for the application. Who can open the app is controlled by the app's Visibility setting.

language.title: Application Language
language.description: Select the UI language for the schedule application (en, pl, de, es).

managerGroup.title: Managers Group Name
managerGroup.description: Name of the YouTrack user group whose members can edit the schedule and see weekly notes.

workerGroup.title: Workers Group Name
workerGroup.description: Name of the YouTrack user group whose members are listed as rows in the schedule. Everyone allowed by the app's Visibility setting can view the schedule (read-only).

absenceProjectName.title: Absence / Leave Item Name
absenceProjectName.description: Label displayed in the project selector for vacation/leave days.
